description: The bar chart, titled "Average Performance," compares the performance of five different methods: Standard, Self-RAG, FactTune, CInGS (w/), and CInGS. The vertical axis represents "Average Performance" on a linear scale from 0 to 60, with major gridlines at intervals of 10. The horizontal axis lists the five methods. Each method is represented by a single colored bar: Standard (orange), Self-RAG (light brown), FactTune (green), CInGS (w/) (blue), and CInGS (dark blue). The performance values are approximately: Standard (~54), Self-RAG (~55), FactTune (~52), CInGS (w/) (~55), and CInGS (~59). The CInGS method shows the highest average performance, while FactTune shows the lowest among the five. The bars are arranged in ascending order of performance from left to right, with CInGS being the tallest.
